as_told.title: Beverly McKittrick interview: Jackie Gleason came home shaken after Nixon visit

plain: One night in the 1970s, President Richard Nixon is said to have turned up at the home of the comedian Jackie Gleason and taken him to Homestead Air Force Base in Florida to see secret UFO material. Michels calls it a "famous story" and gives the year as 1973. Elsewhere he says Nixon may have been drunk and came with no Secret Service guards. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan, citing a magazine article, says Gleason saw a crashed UFO and "biological alien bodies that were in freezers," and became a UFO fan after that. The story goes back to Gleason's ex-wife, Beverly McKittrick, in an interview with the National Enquirer, a tabloid newspaper, in 1983. The writer Bryce Zabel and the researcher Grant Cameron both name her as the source. Cameron says she told it this way: either Gleason was out "fooling around with women" or it really happened, because he came home badly shaken. Michels also cites a book called The Great One. If true, a sitting president would have shown alien remains to a TV star.
